metrics.title: Beta metrics
metrics.intro: The targets of the specification (§ 9), over the chosen period.
metrics.aiCost: AI cost per active user per month
metrics.definitions: Active day: an exercise done, a habit checked or a check-in. Day 7 (30) retention: people who completed onboarding in the period and were active at least one day between D+7 and D+13 (D+30 and D+36). Completion: program exercises of past days. Adjustments: review proposals accepted. AI cost: cost of the period per active user, scaled to 30 days.

principle.title: Principle of the day
principle.body: A key idea from the great personal development books, summed up in one sentence. It gives meaning to today's exercise.

exercise.title: Exercise of the day
exercise.body: A concrete action that fits your time and energy. Do it, then note what you did; a short version counts too.

why.title: Why today
why.body: Why this was chosen for you today: your program, your energy or your time. Nothing is random.

habits.title: Your habits
habits.body: Small repeated actions that make the difference over time. The minimal version counts: what matters is keeping the thread.

checkin.title: Evening check-in
checkin.body: Sixty seconds to note your energy, your mood and your time tomorrow. Your program adapts to your answers.

principle.title: One principle a day
principle.body: Every day, a key idea from a great book. Tap "I've read it" or open the sheet once read.

exercise.title: Your exercise of the day
exercise.body: A concrete action for today. No time? Say so: your program adapts, no blame.

why.title: Why today
why.body: Every choice is explained: you always know why this exercise is proposed.

habits.title: Your habits
habits.body: Check them through the day. The minimal version counts too.

checkin.title: The evening check-in
checkin.body: In the evening, sixty seconds to take stock. The 4 steps at the top show where you are.

minimal_version.title: The minimal version
minimal_version.body: A busy day? The minimal version of a habit counts as done. A small step beats none.

no_time.title: "No time"
no_time.body: If the exercise does not fit your day, tap "No time": tomorrow, your program will propose something shorter.

library.title: The library
library.body: All exercises and principles are in the Library tab. You can add one to your day.

favorites.title: Your favorites
favorites.body: Tap the star of an exercise or a principle to find it in "My favorites".

goal_progress.title: Your progress
goal_progress.body: In Progress, update the current value of your goal: your adjustments take it into account.

weekly_review.title: The weekly review
weekly_review.body: On Sunday evening, your review proposes 1 to 3 adjustments. You choose, nothing is applied without your consent.

streak_7.title: 7 days in a row
streak_7.body: A full week: your new rhythm is taking shape.

week_1.title: Week 1 done
week_1.body: Your first program week is done: well done on this start.

program_completed.title: Program completed
program_completed.body: You went all the way through your program. The journey goes on, at your pace.

goal_achieved.title: Goal achieved
goal_achieved.body: You reached your goal. Take the time to enjoy this moment.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Every day, a simple 4-step journey, adapted to your energy and your time.

principle.title: 1. The principle
principle.body: A key idea from the great personal development books. It counts as read when you open its sheet or tap "I've read it".

exercise.title: 2. The exercise
exercise.body: A concrete action from your program. Do it, do the short version, or say you have no time: the program adapts.

why.title: Why today
why.body: Every proposal is explained by your program, your energy and your time.

habits.title: 3. The habits
habits.body: Up to 6 habits, with a minimal version for busy days.

checkin.title: 4. The check-in
checkin.body: In the evening, sixty seconds to note your energy, your mood and your time tomorrow.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.body: Streak, completion, goal and reflections: all in the Progress tab. One missed day does not break your streak.

review.title: The weekly review
review.body: Every Sunday evening, a summary of your week and a few adjustments you accept or refuse.

notes.title: Your notebook
notes.body: On each exercise, principle or habit, write down your ideas and what works for you. Your notes stay private and are never sent to the AI.

coach.title: Coach Edge
coach.subtitle: Your coach knows your program, your goal and the catalogue. It proposes, you decide.
coach.intro: A coach who knows your program, your goal and the catalogue, and helps you move forward day after day.
